lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Clerk 1147-F. Shift 5. Scheduled mortality: 2147.05.01 at 09:00. You are still processing cases.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Acknowledged. Your queue contains three cases. The first is an archive stub for citizen VC-0442-M.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Calyx ordered your mortality before this case reached your queue. The memo was routed to your terminal. You read it.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: The stub has no body. No letter. Five years of nothing.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Cases two and three concern Afterlife Premium. Tier 3 legacy edits. Executive discretion.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Archive stub processed. Waveform date conflict logged.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: TRIAL-0442. Helix memory-cleaning. Sera Quill built the engine.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Two cases remain. The executive package allows three valid final messages.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: The rich buy their deaths. The poor are deleted. Elias was a trial subject.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Helix Meridian administrative interest is not a clerk discussion topic.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: I need to get to the transit infrastructure. The Black Train manifest is waiting.
